rationale.text: The page is served as application/xhtml+xml and holds one title element, in the XHTML namespace, as a child of head, with text. The test asks for a page title given by the title tag; the document type does not change that. The custom check accepts application/xhtml+xml documents (its step 1) and answers no_fault under its step 3, so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only.

citations.quote: Chaque page web a-t-elle un titre de page (balise `<title>`) ?
Retrouver dans le document le titre structuré au moyen d’un élément `<title>` ;
Si c’est le cas, **le test est validé**.
